attorneys: N. Murry Edwards, James A. Waech-ter and Douglas H. Jones for petitioner. Maurice G. Roberts, Cornelius H. Skinker, Jr., William R. Gentry, Charles A. Helsell and John W. Freels for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Missouri denied for want of a final judgment.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Murphy are of the opinion that the petition should be granted.
